reason: The candidate set is sufficiently established. All 27 selected reflections are indexed by one superstructure lattice (M20 = 77), and the submitted Z = 1 orthorhombic cell is the primitive setting of that metric. The trajectory instantiated the chemically motivated 2H framework and enumerated the Ba-pair orderings into Pmm2, Cmcm, and P6_3/mmc classes; weak superstructure reflections and resolved peak splitting that are forbidden or intensity-inconsistent in the higher-symmetry classes support the fully ordered Pmm2 realization rather than an averaged model. The submitted CIF gives the exact composition with unit occupancies, round-trips as Pmm2, has plausible contacts (Co-O 1.75-2.13 angstrom), and its independently parameterized coordinates account for the complete 5-90 degree profile with no unmatched reflections and an unweighted whole-profile residual of about 4.45%. Although no standardized comparable Rwp was supplied, the available fit and trajectory do not leave a scientifically motivated discrete ordering or framework alternative likely to improve the candidate set materially.
